content: Misdiagnosis is a frequent issue in diabetes classification, with up to 40% of adults who actually have type 1 diabetes being incorrectly diagnosed as having type 2 diabetes. This diagnostic challenge is not limited to type 1 and type 2 diabetes; it also affects other forms of diabetes, such as maturity-onset diabetes of the young (MODY), which is often mistakenly identified as type 1 diabetes.
